notes:
2026-09-12: migrated to the unified Fact/annotations model. Real oracle text (Scryfall-confirmed, data/fin/fin_scryfall.json #75): "Choose target creature you control and target Equipment. Gain control of that Equipment until end of turn. Attach it to the chosen creature. When you lose control of that Equipment this turn, if it's attached to a creature you control, unattach it." Instant, {U}.

Baseline: self-cast ({event:'cast', from:'Hand', target:'self'}) + self-graveyard ({to:'Graveyard', controller:'you', subject:'self'}), both typeLine-anchored 'Instant', same pair fate-of-the-sun-cryst/aerith-rescue-mission's own Instants already establish.

Two real ability facts, both newly PROMOTED vocabulary (previously PARKED in scripts/verify-synergy.mjs's own PARKED_ACTION_FNS, despite the underlying actions already being real/wired): (1) `{event:'gainControl', controller:'you', recipient:'you', target:{types:{has:['Equipment']}}, targeted:true, untilEndOfTurn:true}` for 'Gain control of that Equipment until end of turn' — gainControl itself was already promoted 2026-09-12 earlier the same day (Stiltzkin, Moogle Merchant/fin-34); this card's own recipient is 'you' (unlike Stiltzkin's 'opp'), and `target` is type-constrained to Equipment (unlike Stiltzkin's unconstrained 'another target permanent'). `untilEndOfTurn:true` is purely documentary (synergy.ts's own field doc comment) — this engine's `state.gainControl` is a one-way, permanent-within-scenario reassignment with NO control-reversion mechanism at all, same simplification zidane-tantalus-thief's/unexpected-request's own identical-duration gainControl effects already document; the field records the real CR duration honestly without claiming the engine enforces it. (2) `{event:'equip', controller:'you', target:{types:{has:['Creature']}}}` for 'Attach it to the chosen creature' — `equip` PROMOTED as part of THIS task (was parked; `actions.equip`/`state.equip` were already real and exercised by 30+ real Equipment cards' own Equip abilities plus this card's own pre-existing custom effect, just never claimable as Fact evidence). `scripts/verify-synergy.mjs` gained `producedEvents`'s new `case 'equip'` (side via the existing `sideOf` name-guessing fallback, since `loggingActions.equip` logs no `controller` field) and `equip` moved from `PARKED_ACTION_FNS` into `explainableFns`. **Known, expected, LARGE side effect, not a regression**: this surfaces real, previously-invisible `fn:'equip'` trace lines as SOFT notes (never hard failures) on ~30 other pool cards' own Equip-ability effects that have no `event:'equip'` Fact of their own yet — same size/shape of side effect `pump`'s own promotion produced pool-wide; not fixed here, out of scope for this single-card task.

The delayed "when you lose control of that Equipment this turn... unattach it" trigger is genuinely NOT modeled: no `unattach`/detach action exists anywhere in this engine (`equip` only ever attaches), and no delayed-trigger-on-control-loss mechanism exists (`turn.ts`'s only delayed-trigger scheduling, `delayUntil`, is keyed on phase/step boundaries, not a `gainControl` event) — documented honestly in `definition.ts`'s own comment and `describe` string, not fabricated.

Sink facts (3, unchanged in kind from the pre-migration v1 model, just re-anchored with real annotations): `{to:'Battlefield', controller:'you', types:{has:['Creature']}}` anchored on 'target creature you control'; `{to:'Battlefield', controller:'you'/'opp', types:{has:['Equipment']}}` (both anchored on the same 'target Equipment' span — the real oracle text names no ownership restriction, so both a self-owned and an opponent-owned Equipment are equally legal targets).

All 7 facts annotated via a new `annotations-authoring.json` + `scripts/compute-annotations.mjs`; added `stolen-uniform` to `scripts/annotation-coverage.mjs`'s `ANNOTATED_CARD_SLUGS`. `Fact.value` computed via `scripts/compute-weights.mjs --slug=stolen-uniform` (all facts resolve to the neutral floor, 1 — no numeric magnitude on either side).

Scenario: kept the existing single flat `harness.ts` scenario (already matches the task's own 'default 1, steal a real opponent Equipment, attach to your own creature' bar) — `you: {creaturesCount:1}` (no own Equipment) + `opponents:[{equipmentCount:1}]` naturally forces `chooseTarget`'s pool-order default to pick the opponent's own Equipment (since `ctx.you`'s own equipment pool is empty), demonstrating the intended 'steal, don't self-equip' case without needing `preferTarget`. Regenerated trace.json (`run-scenarios.mjs --slug=stolen-uniform`) — real trace shows `fn:'gainControl'` (controller:'you', target: opponent's placeholder equipment) followed by `fn:'equip'` (target: 'Grizzly Bears', the real filler creature you control) followed by the Instant's own real move to Graveyard.

`npx vite-node functional-model/scripts/verify-synergy.mjs stolen-uniform`: 0 hard failures, 0 soft notes. Full pool (319 v2 cards checked): 5 pre-existing hard failures, none attributable to this card or this task (al-bhed-salvagers/black-mage-s-rod/sahagin/stuck-in-summoner-s-sanctum/ultros-obnoxious-octopus — all confirmed via `git status` to belong to a concurrent peer session's own in-flight migrations, none touching gainControl/equip vocabulary). `npx vitest run functional-model`: 349/349. Real `find-synergies.mjs` diff, isolated via `git stash push -- .../stolen-uniform/synergy.json` (re-run immediately before/after to rule out concurrent-pool drift, confirmed by a second identical isolated re-check): 0 lost, 0 gained — the 13 pre-existing 'graveyard presence' outbound matches are relabeled 'moves to graveyard' (cosmetic correctness improvement from the real `to`/`subject` zone-CHANGE semantics, not a match-count change); the new gainControl/equip facts create zero NEW pool matches today (no sink anywhere wants `event:'gainControl'` or `event:'equip'` yet — expected, same 'promotes vocabulary for a future payoff card, doesn't itself create a match today' pattern every other action-fn promotion this project has made already establishes).
knownGaps: The delayed "when you lose control of that Equipment this turn... unattach it" trigger is genuinely unmodeled — no unattach/detach action exists in this engine, and no delayed-trigger-on-control-loss mechanism exists either. Not a Fact-vocabulary gap alone; would need real new engine primitives.

gainControl's 'until end of turn' duration (Fact.untilEndOfTurn:true) is purely documentary — state.gainControl has no control-reversion mechanism at all, same pre-existing simplification zidane-tantalus-thief/unexpected-request already document for their own identical-duration effects.

equip promoted to real Fact vocabulary as part of this task; ~30 other pool cards' own Equip abilities now surface real, previously-invisible fn:'equip' soft notes in verify-synergy.mjs until each gets its own event:'equip' Fact authored — expected, out of scope here.
